job.text: Press "Ask the AI the same hard sum 5 times" and watch what comes back. One unchanged question, five confident answers. Note: this is a warm-up, not a graded puzzle. There is no move to add yet. When you see what is happening, check the box to unlock the next level.

moves.label: I see — it's guessing, not calculating

text.plain: I see — the AI is guessing at this, not calculating it.
text.tech: I see — the AI is predicting a plausible product, not computing it.

rules.feedback: Exactly. Same question, five different answers, every one stated with full confidence. Now you'll learn the move that takes the math out of its hands.
rules.lesson: The AI guesses; it does not compute.

output.showNote: This 'check' only asks 'are the five answers all equal?' — it can't go red on a single run. That's a bad check. You'll learn to spot those in World 4.

rules.feedback: Same question, five answers. The AI is predicting what a product looks like, not multiplying. Asking again just rolls the dice again. When you see it, check the box.
rules.lesson: The AI guesses; it does not compute.

output.showNote: None of the five is 19,945,311. Compare the last three digits of runs 2 and 4 — they don't match.

hints.nudge: Did it give you the same answer twice?
hints.gap: Look at the last three digits of runs 2 and 4 — they don't match. One unchanged question can't have five right answers.
hints.moves: There's nothing to fix here yet. Check the box; the next level gives you the move.

whatYouDoDifferently.naive: Ask again, hope the next answer is the right one.
whatYouDoDifferently.rewrite: Stop asking it to do the math at all — the next level shows you how.

template.plain: Ask your AI a long multiplication (like 6,847 × 2,913) three times in a row. If the answers differ, you've just watched it guess.
template.tech: Prompt a long multiplication three times with code tools off. Differing answers are the guess; turn code on and they lock.

notes: ChatGPT: without its code tool on, the answers often differ. Turn code on and they lock — that's the preview of World 2's move.
Copilot in Excel: =6847*2913 in a cell is always exact — that's the contrast.
A chat AI that can't run code: expect it to differ, and never accept "I checked, it's right" on a number it only guessed.
